data.RNG: np.random.default_rng(seed), one independent generator per instance; PCG64
data.label: same official generator settings, newly generated instances; not original paper item lists
data.pilot_difference: Saved pilot used floor(clip(45*Weibull(3),1,100)); official B generator uses np.round.

evaluation: unchanged cpu.pack / priorities; arrival order; only opened feasible bins; read-only float64 bins; numeric finite same-length ndarray; argmax first tie; open only when none feasible
selection: All nine outputs selected by prior pilot_dev, frozen before new data. No test-based selection or changes.
primary_delta: control bins minus raw_fragment_gp bins; positive means fragment GP better
reporting: All three search seeds separately, then equally weighted across three seeds. Same 30 instances paired within each seed. Do not treat 90 seed-instance rows as independent.
interval: Paired instance bootstrap, 10000 draws, PCG64(900001), percentile 95%; average the three frozen seeds within each instance first. Conditional on these nine outputs, not search-seed population uncertainty.
